brand.name: Khayali
brand.tagline: Every child, the hero of their own story.

hero.eyebrow: Personalised storybooks for nurseries, schools & brands
hero.title: Turn every child into the hero of a story that teaches them something real.
hero.body: Khayali creates beautifully illustrated, personalised storybooks that help nurseries, schools, clinics and brands teach values like healthy eating, honesty and hand-washing — with the child's own name, avatar and language.

marketing.trustBar: Built for nurseries, schools, clinics and children's brands worldwide

familyCallout.title: A parent yourself?
familyCallout.body: Create a free family account and make a personalised story for your own child — then invite friends and earn free stories when they subscribe.

contactPage.title: Contact us
contactPage.body: Have a question, an issue with a story, or need help with your nursery's account? Message us on WhatsApp and we'll get back to you.
contactPage.unavailable: WhatsApp contact isn't set up yet - check back soon.
contactPage.responseTime: We usually reply within a few hours during UAE business hours.

staffPage.title: Staff
staffPage.body: Give your nursery's team their own logins so more than one person can add children and create stories. Nothing here affects billing - only the owner (that's you) can change the plan or payment details.
staffPage.roleOwnerDesc: Full access, including billing and inviting staff. There's exactly one per nursery (whoever signed up).
staffPage.roleAdminDesc: Everything staff can do, plus deleting a child's profile.
staffPage.roleStaffDesc: Add children, create and approve stories, request parent consent.
staffPage.inviteLinkReady: Share this link with them — it lets them set up their own login and join your team.
staffPage.inviteWhatsappText: You've been invited to join our team on Khayali — set up your login here:

staffAccept.title: Join your team
staffAccept.body: You've been invited to join {tenantName} as {role}. Set a password below to activate your login.
staffAccept.invalidOrExpired: This invite link is invalid or has expired. Ask the owner to send you a new one.
staffAccept.alreadyUsed: This invite has already been used.
staffAccept.emailConfirmationPending: Almost there — check your email to confirm your address, then open this same link again to finish joining.

consent.parentBody: {orgName} would like to create a personalised storybook for {childName}. This uses the child's first name and a cartoon avatar you choose — never a real photo unless you separately opt in.
consent.parentPhotoNotice: This request also asks to use a photo of {childName}. If you grant consent, {orgName} will upload a reference photo that is sent securely to Google's Gemini AI to generate a stylised, cartoon-style illustrated character for the story. The photo itself is never shown, printed, or shared as a photo — only used to guide the illustration. You can withdraw this consent at any time, which deletes the photo immediately.
consent.withdrawConfirm: Withdrawing consent will stop new stories being created and will delete this child's existing story files.
consent.declined: No problem — no story will be created.
consent.withdrawn: Consent withdrawn. Story files are being deleted.

stories.title: Stories
stories.regenerateStartedBody: We'll swap in the new illustration as soon as it's ready - this page updates on its own.
stories.downloadFailedBody: The file isn't ready yet, or something went wrong. Try again in a moment.
stories.bulkZipFailedBody: The file isn't ready yet, or something went wrong. Try again in a moment.
stories.suggestIdeaBody: Have an idea for a new habit or topic we should turn into a story? Tell us about it below.
stories.suggestIdeaTopicPlaceholder: e.g. Sharing toys, Recycling, Trying new foods
stories.suggestIdeaDescriptionQuestion: Why does this matter to your families?
stories.suggestIdeaSuccessBody: Your idea has been saved. Tap below to also send it straight to our team on WhatsApp for the fastest response.

referrals.title: Invite friends, earn free stories
referrals.body: Share your invite link. When someone signs up with it and subscribes, you get free stories added to your account — matching whatever plan they choose.
referrals.stats: {pending} invite(s) pending, {rewarded} completed — you've earned {stories} free stories so far.
referrals.pageBody: Every person who signs up with your link and subscribes earns you free stories — automatically, matching whatever plan they choose. No limit on how many people you invite.
referrals.step1: Share your link — by WhatsApp, email, or however you'd reach them.
referrals.step2: They sign up with it and subscribe to any plan.
referrals.step3: You get free stories added to your account automatically — matching their plan, no waiting.
referrals.shareText: Join me on Khayali and create a free personalised storybook for your child!
